name: Validate lead intake and route review outcomes with Code and Switch

parameters.content:
## Validate lead intake and route review outcomes with Code and Switch

### How it works

Run Synthetic Preflight manually starts a batch of nine fictional leads. Generate Synthetic Examples supplies edge cases. Evaluate Lead Preflight normalizes text, email, phone, and UTM fields, validates event and contact fields, and detects repeated event IDs or emails within that batch. Route by Preflight Status sends eight statuses to Decision nodes that retain assessed fields and add route_decision. Unexpected statuses go to a manual-review fallback.

### Setup

- Import this workflow into an isolated n8n instance and keep it inactive.
- No credentials or external accounts are required. All nodes are built-in Manual Trigger, Code, Switch, Edit Fields (Set), or Sticky Note nodes.
- Execute Run Synthetic Preflight manually, then inspect Evaluate Lead Preflight and the matching Decision outputs.
- Expect nine assessed rows: two READY_FOR_REVIEW and one in each of the seven other named branches. Default fixtures do not invoke fallback.

### Customization and limits

Add fictional cases in Generate Synthetic Examples. Duplicate checks reset each run. Email and phone checks validate format, not deliverability or ownership. This educational workflow makes no network requests, sends no messages, writes no CRM records, and is not a production lead-handling integration.

## Start synthetic preflight

Manual trigger that starts the fictional lead validation preflight run.

## Generate and evaluate leads

Creates fictional lead examples and evaluates them with code-based preflight rules before routing.

## Route validation status

Switches each evaluated lead into the appropriate outcome branch based on its preflight status.

## Primary review outcomes

Top branch cluster that sets route decisions for ready-for-review, phone-only review, missing contact, and bad email outcomes.

## Batch and event outcomes

Middle branch cluster that sets decisions for duplicate or same-email batch review cases, plus invalid event holds.

## Malformed and fallback holds

Bottom branch cluster that handles malformed input and catches any unexpected status by holding it for review.
